subject.title: fix(agents): reject identity updates for unknown agents

question: Should `openclaw agents set-identity` become a strict update-only command for all existing users, with custom-agent creation required through `openclaw agents add`?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility change to a public CLI workflow, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling even if the implementation is otherwise sound.

options.title: Adopt strict update-only behavior
options.body: Approve rejecting unknown IDs and require users and automation to create custom agents through `openclaw agents add`.

options.title: Preserve creation compatibility
options.body: Keep the prior implicit-creation behavior or define a separately documented migration path if existing setup workflows rely on it.

recommendation.title: Adopt strict update-only behavior
recommendation.body: Approve rejecting unknown IDs and require users and automation to create custom agents through `openclaw agents add`.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to the active PR and authored the proposed command-contract change.
